items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: Jack Carey, he was manager. Oscar Silvestre, was cornetist. Old man Willie Umfrey was clarinet. Bebe Mathews was drummer. That's Bill Mathews' brother. He's dead now. He died. Jimmy Johnson was bass violin player. And Charlie Moore was guitar player.

ctx.x: When did you start working in Storyville? When did you begin playing piano over there? Had you played other places before you went to Lula White's? Oh, sure.

You see, a letter band, Jack Carey's Orchestra, called Crescent Orchestra. Do you want to know the name of the man? Yes, if you can remember. Well, the band, the name of the men, the band. Jack Carey, he was manager. Oscar Silvestre, was cornetist. Old man Willie Umfrey was clarinet. Bebe Mathews was drummer. That's Bill Mathews' brother. He's dead now. He died. Jimmy Johnson was bass violin player. And Charlie Moore was guitar player.
